🎬 Life’s a Breeze (2013)

Life’s a Breeze follows the chaotic adventures of an Irish family whose attempt to do something thoughtful for their elderly mother turns into an unexpected disaster. Set in Dublin during a period of financial hardship, the story begins when Colm and his family decide to surprise his mother, Nan, by cleaning and renovating her cluttered home while she is away. Believing they are helping her start fresh, they throw away years of accumulated belongings, including an old mattress that appears completely worthless. However, their good intentions quickly backfire when Nan reveals that she had secretly hidden nearly one million euros in cash inside the discarded mattress. Suddenly realizing that the family’s potential fortune has been sent to a landfill, Colm launches a desperate search to recover the missing money before it disappears forever. As news of the lost fortune spreads, the situation attracts growing attention, creating hilarious misunderstandings, unexpected complications, and increasing tension among family members. Meanwhile, Nan’s granddaughter Emma becomes involved in the search, offering a fresh perspective on the family’s struggles and relationships. Through chaotic adventures, emotional conversations, and moments of unexpected kindness, the family begins discovering that money can create as many problems as it promises to solve. Combining Irish humor, heartfelt performances, and entertaining family drama, Life’s a Breeze explores love, greed, financial struggles, family loyalty, and the importance of appreciating what truly matters in life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m

🎥 Director: Lance Daly

✍️ Writer: Lance Daly
